items.raw_excerpt: Cyberabad Traffic Police impose 60-day traffic diversions near Khajaguda Junction for water pipelines, guiding three detours around Nanakramguda and IT corridor.
items.summary_en: Cyberabad police will close some roads near Khajaguda Junction for 60 days. The work is to lay new water pipelines. Drivers are asked to use three other roads around Nanakramguda and the main tech corridor instead.
items.summary_ko: 사이버가바드 경찰은 카자가우다 교차로 주변 도로를 60일간 통행 제한한다. 새 수도관을 놓기 위한 조치다. 경찰은 나나크람구다와 정보기술 도로 구간을 이용하는 우회로 세 곳을 안내했다.
items.title_en: Road Closures Near Khajaguda Junction for 60 Days; Police Offer Three Detour Routes
items.title_ko: 카자가우다 교차로 60일간 통행 제한, 사이버가바드 경찰이 우회로 세 곳 안내
items.title_original: Khajaguda junction restrictions may push traffic onto internal roads; Cyberabad Police map three alternative routes

items.raw_excerpt: With AI, economic shifts and a tightening job market making traditional roles feel less secure, many internationals are looking for a fresh start. We spoke to an expert about how to successfully switch careers in Germany.
items.summary_en: An expert says people should stay curious when they want to change careers in Germany. Many foreign workers look for a new start as AI and a tighter job market change the work market.
items.summary_ko: 직업을 바꾸려는 사람들에게 호기심을 유지하라고 조언한 전문가가 있다. AI와 Occupy 좁아지는 노동시장으로 외국인 노동자들이 새 출발을 찾는 Vinext가 늘고 있다.
items.title_en: Expert Gives Job Change Advice in Germany
items.title_ko: 독일 직업 전환 조언, 전문가의 핵심은 '호기심'
items.title_original: ‘Get curious’: Expert advice on how to change careers in Germany

items.raw_excerpt: There are plenty of fantastic festivals taking place across France in October, from jazz and electronic music to wine and food. Here are seven to get in your diary and there's something for almost everyone's taste.
items.summary_en: Many small festivals run across France in October. They cover jazz, electronic music, wine, and food. We picked seven good ones for your calendar, and there is one for almost everyone.
